```sql
WITH l AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           ol.order_id,
           pv.id                    AS variant_id,
           sum(ol.quantity)         AS q,
           sum(ol.line_total_cents) AS r
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY pv.product_id, ol.order_id, pv.id
), agg AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(DISTINCT order_id)   AS order_count,
           sum(q)::bigint             AS quantity,
           sum(r)                     AS revenue_cents,
           count(DISTINCT variant_id) AS variant_count
      FROM l
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       a.order_count,
       a.quantity,
       a.revenue_cents,
       a.variant_count
  FROM agg a
  JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id
 ORDER BY a.quantity DESC, a.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

Het origineel sorteert ruim 81.000 brede rijen (met sku, naam en merk) op `p.id, o.id` voor de `count(DISTINCT ...)`, en die sort loopt over naar schijf. Hier wordt eerst met smalle uuid-kolommen per (product, order, variant) en daarna per product geaggregeerd; de productgegevens worden pas daarna bij de ongeveer 1.750 resultaatrijen gejoind. De dubbele som wordt naar `bigint` gecast, zodat de kolomtypen (bigint/numeric) gelijk blijven aan die van het origineel.
